Ananta Capital Buys Majority Stake in Personal Care Brand Phitku

Ananta Capital has acquired a majority stake in Phitku, a personal care brand described as one of India's fastest-growing. The details of the transaction were not provided. This investment signifies continued interest in India's expanding consumer goods market.
